name: cmd-usage-kb
description: 命令用法知识库 —— 记录 / 搜索 / 统计高频命令用法，前后端分离

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.killports: eval "$(grep -E '^(BACKEND_PORT|FRONTEND_PORT)=' .env 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:${BACKEND_PORT:-3031} -ti:${FRONTEND_PORT:-5133} 2>/dev/null | sort -u | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'ports cleared'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
